notes.title: Major update: 0.3 | Hamlets update (Hamlet, trade & roads)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hear ye, hear ye, King, Queens and Monarchs![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/dfe903511c39d5564e9e6570c4f54d6f9baaa2d7.png"][/img][/p][p]Today, we are releasing our Hamlets (and Trade) update that I arbitrarily decided to name "[b]Hit the road update[/b]" without consulting anyone (don't tell the devs!)[/p][p]In this update, we are implementing the [b]Advisor Mode,[/b] the [b]Hamlets[/b] and [b]trade[/b] system, [b]roads[/b] adapting to your evolving city, and a highly requested feature: a [b]refined destruction tool[/b] that will only delete the building and not the plot![/p][p]This update is also our biggest [b]Optimization update[/b]. [/p][p][b][u]Disclaimer[/u][/b]: Due to heavy changes in the system and build, your saves in 0.2 are not compatible with 0.3. However, we have created a 0.2 branch so you can transfer your save there. PTB Saves are not compatible either, make sure to switch to the Main branch again if you haven't already, by clicking on the "Selected Version"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/7a96b5e45a889fb8075fa399b41e9dd1847b0a49.png"][/img][/p][h1]
Key features[/h1][h3]New “Advisor” game mode[/h3][list][*][p]This new game mode will offer stronger challenges for players who are up to the task![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/32237e6e66dc46474b90d9f7f3482650f987974b.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]We've worked hard on optimization. We knew it was one of the biggest issue tied to the game and we are happy to present our biggest optimization update. We are still working on some details along the way but you should notice many improvements while playing![/p][/*][/list][h3]Hamlets[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/82a10f498abf4fe0969eb0e20840051ea40dcbd3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Hamlets will allow you to expand your territory and bring new resources to your territory. You can access the menu via the Town Hall. While your Burgomaster will not be available for any other activities, they will bring their skills and perks to the new hamlet![/p][/*][*][p]Gather camps now need to be placed inside the city construction area[/p][/*][/list][h3]Trade system[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/3f71f8f384ee0369a9cbaa82d9201f171e24e490.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p]Hilde's Trade Post will be unlocked with the Hamlets and will allow you to obtain gold in a different way than expanding, so you can have control over your growth.[/p][/*][*][p]This was requested by the community several times. It was originally suggested to be tied with the market itself but we wanted a system that would make more sense: if we were to use the marketplace, it would have been implied getting the money from your population. [/p][/*][*][p]This feature will allow you to have a different form of income without implementing taxes that we feel are a bit too idle.[/p][/*][*][p]We hope it will make your progression interesting! Please let us know your thoughts![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Resource depletion, agriculture and balancing[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/d0dd0db1b046a78fcf4e872f1b10149bcab489ff.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]With the introduction of the Hamlets and Trade system, we have changed the resource depletion and regeneration. They will deplete a bit faster and you will have to be a bit more careful with the management of your production chain. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We have also deleted the agriculture zones, so you can now place your orchards, vineyards and farms anywhere you want![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Mechanics and core changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]New deletion tool and the ability to cancel construction[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/mdEFzUa.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The building deleting feature was highly requested by our community and it took us a bit more time than expected to implement it with a satisfying result. [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/FiyDdIw.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]We also implemented a "Cancel" construction feature, that will allow you to cancel it if you missclick or change your mind.[/p][/*][*][p]It has a few ripple effects on the spatial puzzle that we were and are still worried about so please let us know what your think![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Changes in narration[/b][/p][list][*][p]When starting a new game, you can now choose to play without narration and without tutorial. [/p][/*][*][p][b]For your first game, the tutorial and narration will be enabled by default. However, as soon as you've progressed a bit in the game, all your subsequent new games will allow you to disable these options as you wish[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/e8bb7c7ff227b413abe819f940702161c8058d23.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]This will allow you to create more freely without reading through the story. This change made us rethink the narration was intertwined with core features. [/p][/*][*][p]We have separated Narrative quests with the “Main Quest” that will unlock new buildings and new elements, you can prioritize easily and differentiate them in the UI, the Advisor will guide you well.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/6193ae7d689530cf1e07f2f3ad30dfb1154c8f29.png"][/img]In “Non Narrative mode”, you will only get the Main quests. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Life, visuals[/h2][list][*][p][b]Citizens and transporter[/b]: your city is coming to life with transporters carts instead of backpacks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fancier roads[/b]: As your city evolve, the roads will evolve with it from dirt to stone to paved roads[/p][/*][*][p][b]Habitation fusion[/b]: Higher-tier habitation sometimes fuses with their neighbor after upgrading[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/TtexAur.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Supporter Pack[/h2][list][*][p]4 more tracks have been added to the Supporter pack![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/379dca50493a5f4865a60f1e9d65d2a329445884.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]0.2 Disclaimer[/b][/h2][p][b][u]Disclaimer[/u][/b]: Due to heavy changes in the system and build, your saves in 0.2 are not compatible with 0.3. However, we have created a 0.2 branch so you can transfer your save there. [/p][list][*][p]Right-click on “City Tales - Medieval Era” > Betas > in “Beta Participation” select “Version_0_2_0”[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/9681243a4fe2e6177a68156b08a917691162c4b4.png"][/img][/p][p]You can find your savegame in [i]{disk}:\\Users\\{username}\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Irregular Shapes\\City Tales\\saves\\{steam_userid}\\[/i][/p][list][*][p]Each folder with a number is a save slot with 0 being your autosave[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1][/h1][h1]Full patchnotes[/h1][h2]Highlight[/h2][list][*][p]Reworks building perks to be the same for all building types[/p][/*][*][p]Companion quest can be given up[/p][/*][*][p]Limiting quests to 2 active companion quests[/p][/*][*][p]Deprecates save prior to 0.3.0.1 + adds deprecated save UI[/p][/*][*][p]Three new quest related to a new Companion[/p][/*][*][p]4 new music tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Hamlets[/p][list][*][p]You can expand your city by creating hamlets and naming one of your trusted companion as burgomaster[/p][/*][*][p]Gather camps now need to be placed inside the city construction area[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New destruction mode[/p][list][*][p]You can destroy a building without destroying its parcel[/p][/*][*][p]In progress constructions can be canceled[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Performances[/p][list][*][p]Many changes have been made to improve the performance of the game, particularly with larger cities[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Carts[/p][list][*][p]NPCs carriers now use carts instead of backpack[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New economy buildings[/p][list][*][p]Eight new production buildings with their unique visuals[/p][/*][*][p]New resources[/p][/*][*][p]New civil building upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Houses can be upgraded one more time[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New “Advisor” game mode for more challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Narration[/p][list][*][p]The city progression and building unlocks are now separate from the main story[/p][/*][*][p]New option to play without the main story[/p][/*][*][p]Each companion has a new quest to further your relationship with them[/p][/*][*][p]Many existing quests and objectives have been reworked[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Building and upgrading civil building have different costs (upgrading a chapel to a church has a different cost than building a church directly)[/p][/*][*][p]Habitations now start with their maximum of inhabitants, instead of gradually growing over a few minutes[/p][h3]Performances (detailed)[/h3][list][*][p]Improves performances of carriers NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of all buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of fields[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of castle[/p][/*][*][p]Improves performances during district creation and building placement[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of the terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of building alert icons[/p][/*][*][p]Improves performances of road creation[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of collectable stones[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Grass has been mowed below collectable resources[/p][/*][*][p]Vegetation fields growing animation has been replaced by a new, more organic one[/p][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Overall rebalancing of the economy to prepare for the new buildings and resources[/p][/*][*][p]Town hall construction area are smaller (but can be extended using hamlets)[/p][/*][*][p]Town hall upgrades and castle construction cost less gold[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked position of resources on maps[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removes fertility zone for animal and vegetation fields[/p][/*][*][p]Add game mode to save tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Updates vinque font for better readability of some letters[/p][/*][*][p]Player name and city name can be longer (from 12 to 16 characters)[/p][/*][*][p]Increases camera panning speed at high altitude[/p][/*][*][p]Adds UI to castle placement[/p][/*][*][p]Influence areas: minimizes overlaps between symbols[/p][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Updates end of EA screen text and buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Reworks perks UI (production wheel, tooltips, icons) 🔵🟣[/p][/*][*][p]Updates destruction buttons UI[/p][/*][*][p]Updates dialogue UI[/p][/*][*][p]Adds hover/pressed state to notification card[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Put all non-English words in italic in dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Removes delay before mouse camera drag and rotation[/p][/*][*][p]Adds specific dialogue per companion to autonomy tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Updates translation team credits (new members, fixed job title)[/p][/*][*][p]Adds perks onboarding[/p][/*][*][p]More mill visual variety[/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixes building a civil building on two houses increases the total number of inhabitants[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes destroying a manufacture or civil building or its parcel that was built on top of a house does not decrease the total number of inhabitants[/p][/*][*][p]Fix sometimes villager cross a district (especially mono-parcel districts) to go behind the district[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes placing a civil building over two habitations only cost the money of one habitation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes placing a building over habitations only cost the money of the current tier (and not the sum of all current and previous tier)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes additional money cost is not actually paid if the district has only one house[/p][/*][*][p]Removes crane from loading screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes fences are badly updated after building or parcel deletion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes visual borders of large collectable resource zones[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes experience gained by buildings was not uniform[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes destruction highlight icon priority (icon was not shown if building had a 3D alert)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes expertise icons in objectives and dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes cannot destroy a district if cannot afford each parcel destruction cost (but can afford total)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes roof pattern[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes map border fog glitches[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes Montalban Meadows inhabitant spawn positions[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Major update: 0.2.0.8 | TactiCon Update
notes.notes: [h3]Greetings Monarchs![/h3][p][/p][p]We hope the summer heat has not been too harsh for you! With TactiCon about to begin, we are delighted to share with you our first Major Update of the year! [/p][p]This Update focuses on the visuals of the game, improving the graphics, reworking all the UI, but also adding some new content like a new map, new music ,and new decorations.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the Update, Monarchs, and feel free to give us feedback on Steam and Discord! Thank you again for your support and all the suggestions you shared with us! [/p][p][/p][h1][b]Update highlights:[/b][/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]New UI for buildings placement, upgrades, dialogues...[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/d90bbe34a77545df813592e19822c9354a44058d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New Map, [i]“Montalba meadows”, [/i]with 3 different starting points[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/0b817f945476ef80696c183c2b1d0154f82d2643.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New decorations to customize your city[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/61a2b36092ddc24752d5849c0599a0db2249ab49.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Graphics improved and polished with more texturing of terrain, color scaling and shadow shader to highlight relief[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/4127db11a66a6883f2d6754e93456807eb9797bf.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Watch our new trailer:[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="vdkmj-VO4AI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Questions about the new Roadmap? notes.title: Our new Roadmap and a teaser on the upcoming update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hear, hear, dear Monarchs![/h3][p][/p][p]Hope you are excited for TactiCon as we will be part of the event with [b]our new update and a sale[/b]! Join us on July 17th to celebrate the best of strategy games with talks, demos and sales![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcKpiZMZ4lsfqTDXGzs0C9zN3kWLEnw4nkRA2rUpP1OCTmvQdlAMjCi2VmyuHGeQySx5RfzSks8-KYI7cs5xxMCoNoE6n414QokAn6LG1DlJDFnHFJ72gcgbIshVEHw5HwRUTrpSA?key=IxSbPn64jOcCmQJIvYafgg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Our updated Roadmap:
[/b][/h3][p]As the title suggests, we’ve revamped our Roadmap: we wanted to dedicate more time to improving key elements, such as the UI and the overall visuals of the game. Therefore, we had to move some content to later updates to focus on the visuals first and foremost.[/p][p][/p][p]You can take a look at the upcoming additions that will be there very soon![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfDPbiifTOniWITqQ8LAG4jVCAS4bRGloqxPF5cycSR8qHJ-kV7fKIxeoLdiFZpCCqiEvSP-rTdVtcHf0_Jn7QWQUgVjPqF8khgPTVA3O3m5KUAHhU-OhexXWIvvZnSnOyLWzuhBA?key=IxSbPn64jOcCmQJIvYafgg"][/img][/p][p]Our priority was to update the visuals and interface of the game before diving into the gameplay itself, and as you can see, there’s still plenty of new content, gameplay-wise, planned for the rest of the year. [/p][p]The next update will be released on [b]July 16th [/b]and here is a small teaser on what you can expect in it! 👀
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdKNlOYJ_9wns7HpKuBc6j38ri3CINRsrfYO7ZeZ_aAAgtvaZpwnI_Hfgs4-W8C0Xzn9auKVxKHnqeZCGSTGrt6ZURzZE31X2JgSWwDOs5mLHYcKxsLMLMtMgTo5fzArA8rkGiDxA?key=IxSbPn64jOcCmQJIvYafgg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also read all your reviews on Steam! Thank you for your kindness, support, and for bringing light on some features that needed to be improved. Among this feedback, the performance was one of the main topics you highlighted, and we can already tell you that we’re currently working on improving the performance issues, and it will be featured in the next update [b]in September.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]As we already stated in previous messages, this Early Access is here to build this game alongside you, our players, so don’t hesitate to join our Discord servers to let us know your suggestions for the future of the game, to share your screenshots, and to discuss with the whole dev team! We also give insights and exclusive information to our Discord members in priority so if you want to know everything before everyone, you know where to find us![/p][p]
>> [url="https://link.irregular-shapes.com/Discord" style="button" buttoncolor="#705dd0"]JOIN DISCORD[/url] <<[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for the upcoming update and take care of yourself, lieges![/p][p][/p][p]-The Irregular Shapes Team -[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.14.5
notes.notes:
Good day to you, Monarchs! 

Today, a small patch to improve some visuals like the Weaving Workshop, and fix bugs, as well as missing texts in localization.

Thank you again for your feedbacks and your amazing screenshots on Discord!

[h2]Changelog v0.1.14.5[/h2]

[h3]Features [/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds “Leave a review” buttons on main menu and end of early access screen
[/list]
[h3]Art [/h3]
[list]
[*] Improves fog of war color based on camera distance
[*] Reworks Weaving Workshop visual
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/47415f309eb7ccf2160766009d659b3469c803fc.png[/img]

 [h3]Bug fixes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes save cannot be loaded when there is previously been a bug that affected building constructions
[*] Fixes blueprints (gather house, castle, …) and decorations can't be rotated when game is paused
[*] Fixes NPCs animation error when a lumbercamp is moved while a tree is falling
[*] Fixes missing text in Stale Wine quest first dialogue in simplified chinese
[*] Fixes two typos in dialogues in German

notes.title: Minor update: 0.1.14.3 | Fixes, visuals, QoL and bright blue sky
notes.notes:
Greetings Monarchs! 

Have you been well? We are very happy to be able to see you play and to receive your support!
Today, we bring you more consistent patch to fix some issues and visuals.

It will also improve details, visuals and QOL in general.

Thank you again for your feedbacks!

[h1] Update highlights: [/h1]
- Reworked visuals for agriculture fields: Reserved plot for farming extension will now be tied to the  main farm to make its purpose clearer.   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/adbd91f1fd4825a13152eb497dceaf70ce28ba90.png[/img]   
- Improved resources collection area: when creating a district or placing a building on a collectable zone, tooltip will now display the updated quantity according to the new area.    
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c6eero5.gif[/img]
- Improved skybox and camera angle (yes, previously it was angled to avoid visualizing the sky too much. It’s prettier now so you can see it.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/f6d4f4044d29625be2027050275c682b449e5e4c.png[/img]
- Increased zoom out capacity
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/edcbb511f3e83c00ca8a310a5b8cf5efc405ff75.png[/img]    
- Fixed issue where you could build outside of the game boundaries

[u]Read the whole patch notes to see the changes in details![/u]

[h1]Full patchnotes[/h1]
[h2] In-game[/h2]
[h3] Collectable zones:[/h3]
[list][*] Previewed quantity will now be visible in collectable zone tooltip while placing buildings and districts
[*]Improved collectable zone tooltip position
[*]Improved position of gather house placement panel so that it does not hide relevant collectable zone[/list]
[h3]Farming extension buildings (windmill, …):[/h3]
[list][*] Changed position of farming extension building parcel (always next to the main building) and reworks visual of that parcel when it’s empty
[list][*] On existing save, farming extension parcels will be automatically moved to respect this new rule[/list][*] Improves farming districts highlighting when building a farming extension[/list]
[h3]Others:[/h3]
[list][*] Welcome quality setting screen
[list][*]Added placeholder to welcome screen quality settings dropdown
        [*] Order of quality settings options has been reversed[/list]    [*]  Clarified the button of the second step of the new game wizard
    [*]  Prioritized farming district building icons over alerts on hover and select
    [*]  Increased max zoom and allows more vertical rotation at some zoom levels
    [*]  Adding validation check that construction is not outside the map (districts, gather houses, castles, decorations).[/list]
[h3]UI QoL:[/h3]
[list][*] Companion assignation panel will now close after assignation
        [*] Adding building name tooltip on building icons (companion assignation panel, companion panel, town hall production tab, ...)
        [*] Resource trend tooltip will now close when opening the resource production chain tooltip
        [*] Adding keyboard shortcut info in decoration placement panel for five first decorations
        [*] Changes font of placement panel alerts and infos
        [*] Removed icon from farming fields
        [*] Prioritizing building icon over alerts when hovering or selecting an urban district
        [*]  Replaced save menu check button by "Ok" button
        [*]  Game menu will now close after saving
   [*]  Added discord and survey links at the end of early access screen[/list]
[h2]Art[/h2]
[list][*]  Reworked visual of the spinning workshop
[*]  Replaced the sky by a nicer one (it’s cute)
[*]  Improved map borders fog of war
[*]  Improved depth of field based on zoom level
[*]  Improved visual positions of performance stages and theaters (On existing save, existing performance stages and theaters visual may be changed)
[*]  Adds animation to the water wheel of the lumber mill
[*]  Reduced size of sawmill visual
[*]  Changed carved stone fences to have rounded top[/list]
[H2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list][*]  Fixed leather rope production chain tooltip
[*]  Lumberjack leveled up tutorial: Fixes wrong dialogue speaker when there are several lumberjacks
[*]  Fixed unlocalized string in save panel
[*]  Fixed “ambiant volume” setting name
[*]  Removed tree fall animation during reshaping tutorial
[*]  Fixed dialogue speaker in "A guest from afar" quest
[*] Fixed building selection SFX is not played
[*]  Stopped removing trees during reshaping tutorial
[*]  Fixed credits in non-16:9 resolutions
[*]  Fixed tier [spoiler]6 houses[/spoiler] wrongfully unlocked (including existing saves) and fixed errors related to them
[*]  Fixed destruction of a building construction before scaffolds are created
[*]  Fixed one supporter pack DLC decoration is not unlocked (including existing saves)
[*]  Fixed an issues where farming zoning could lead to higher parcel count even if area looks smaller
[*]  Changed  old French "bon jour" into modern French "bonjour"
[*]  Fixed black lines in fog of war on map borders
[*]  Fixed iron ore shadows
[*]  Fixed shininess of berry bushes when seen from far away
[*]  Fixed an error that made notifications and building icon go crazy
[*]  Slightly improved performances of district creation and gather house placement
[*]  Fixed decoration and gather house placement rotation speed that was frame rate dependent
[*]  Fixed issue when farming building selection SFX was not played when selecting the whole farming district
[*]  Fixed an issue where town hall construction limit was not shown while placing decorations
[*]  Fixed "Montalba plains" map population spawn positions
[*]  Fixed vsync setting is lost after a quality setting change[/list]

notes.title: Early Access release date, our demo and a Screenshot Contest!
notes.notes:
Greetings monarchs and builders of cities!

You may have received the news during the Future Game Show Spring 2025: we're coming to [b]Early Access on May 22nd[/b]! More information will be communicated soon, if you have questions about our Early Access, feel free to ask them in the comment of this Steam News and we will respond to it in an upcoming FAQ news!

[h3]Watch our short trailer revealed for the FGS:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=_qwY-AsifgU;full][/previewyoutube]
We're part of the Steam City Builder & Colony Sim Fest with our free demo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/427a4f5017194a09d8feb09f18471ca6f4e13308.png[/img]

[h1][b]Demo content[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Build and grow your city from a small village into a bustling kingdom.
[*] Freeform, hand-drawn district system.
[*] First map.
[*] Complete demo tutorial.
[*] Construct up to 41 different buildings, including:
[list][*] Upgrade your houses up to Tier 4 by catering to their dwellers' needs.
[*] Build, upgrade, and manage 10 civil buildings, each with its own influence area system.[/list]
[*] Meet 8 of our 12 Companions.
[list][*] Their storylines remain a mystery 🤫, but they will offer their skills to help you with the Perks and Progression system.[/list][*] Build your first Creation—the Castle!
[*] Original soundtrack.
[*] Procedural building generation: each structure is unique, which brings more life to your city.
[*] Localization: switch between English, German, Simplified Chinese, French, Russian, and Ukrainian.
[/list]
[h3][url=https://link.irregular-shapes.com/alphaSurvey]>> FEEDBACK FORM <<[/url][/h3]
We'd also love to have you in our Discord community. Join and share your screenshots, Let's Plays, and other content!

[h3][url=https://link.irregular-shapes.com/Discord]>> JOIN DISCORD <<[/url][/h3]

[h3][b]Known major issues that we're already working on[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Performance issues[/b]: Stuttering, lag, loading time, temp spike & crashes: We are aware of stuttering or high GPU/CPU usage even with high end PC.  We are currently working on improving this. However, this will take some time and will be more likely implemented later, as we improve both the game and performances.
[*] [b]Wide screen UI issuesUltrawide and wide resolution UI issue:[/b] We are aware that the UI will not scale properly on widescreen and ultra widescreen. We are working on updating the UI and fixing those issues but some might be tied to bigger changes that will come closer to Early Access and won’t be in the demo.
[/list]
We also have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3443034351]Steam Guide of the FAQ[/url] that can help you through the demo.

[h3][b]Screenshot Contest[/b][/h3]

We loved all the amazing cities you already shared with us and we thought we could celebrate the Steam City Builder & Colony Sim Fest and reward your creativity at the same time through a contest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/c827ca29721370ba0618b62c7098f2c57d524e22.png[/img]
The contest goal is simple: create your dream city with the City Tales - Medieval Era free demo on Steam and share a screenshot of your city with us!

What are the rules?
[list]
[*] The contest is hosted on X, Bluesky (don't forget to add #CityTales to your post so we can take it into account) and Discord with the tag Contest to add to your screenshot in our new forum channel for screenshots!
[*] On[b] April 3rd[/b], we will announce two winners who will receive as a prize a Steam key for the game when the Early Access starts (on May 22nd)!
[*] Be creative with your city, you can even name them, find them a lore or just stick to aesthetic criterias if you prefer!
[/list]
We can't wait to see all the wonderful tales each stone of your cities will tell.

Have fun during the event!

Greetings monarchs and land shapers!

We are still working on performances and gearing up for Early Access (it's coming soon!) but we are also working on some changes for the demo:

[list][*] Fixes  Quest "On top of things": Quest was validated twice if both objectives were already done when the quest starts.
[*] Fixes missing French and German translation in Town hall upgrade tooltip
